title: Kudin kowane faranti, kare masu rashin lafiyan baƙi, samun kuɗi lafiya

say: Kudin kowane faranti, kare masu rashin lafiyan baƙi, kuma a biya su lafiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na uku na Kayan Kayan Abinci da Kariyar Abinci: farashi, allergens da gudanar da sabis na ƙwararru.
Yawancin masu dafa abinci na gida suna farashi ta hanyar ji, sannan sun gama babban aiki a gajiye, ba tare da kusan komai ba. Maganin takardar kuɗi ne.

say: Mu bi Ronke. Waɗannan farashin kusan misalai ne kawai. Yi amfani da farashin kasuwancin ku a ranar da kuka faɗi.
Kayayyakin sun kai kimanin naira 224,200. Kaza kadai shine 126,000 na wancan, sama da kashi 40 na jimillar.
Sa'an nan boye halin kaka mutane manta. Gas, kusan 12,000. Fakiti, cokali da nailan na fakiti 110, kusan 22,000.
Sufuri, kusan 15,000. Kuma mataimaka biyu a 10,000 kowanne, 20,000.
Jimlar kudin aikin naira 293,200 ne. Wanda aka raba da faranti 100, kowanne faranti ya kai kimanin naira 2,932. Duk wani abu da ke ƙasa wanda ke asarar kuɗi.

Markup riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashi. Margin riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashin siyarwa. Hada su shine ya sa yawancin masu cin abinci ke samun kasa da yadda suke zato. Don farashi tare da gefe, raba farashin da 1 ya rage gefe.

panel.heading: Margin, ba alama ba
items: Farashin = farashi ÷ (1 - gefe)

Kwanan wata farashin ku; ambaton ingancin kwanaki 7

say: Rashin lafiyar abinci na iya zama mai tsanani kuma yana da haɗari ga rayuwa, kuma dafa abinci baya cire yawancin allergens. Ko da alama daga cokali ɗaya zai iya isa. Groundnut yana ɓoye a cikin suya yaji, kuli-kuli da wasu ƙananan sara.

panel.heading: Inda allergens ke ɓoye
items: Groundnut: suya yaji, kuli-kuli, kananan sara
Crayfish: jollof, stews, egusi
Kwai: moi moi, puff puff, salad cream
Alkama: kek nama, chin chin, wrappers

Hatimi da lakabi: BABU GROUNDNUT

panel.rule: Ba tabbata ba? Ka ce: don Allah kar a ci shi. Kar a taba tsammani.

say: Kudin Ronke na Naira 420,000 ya nemi a ba ta kashi 50%, 210,000, kafin ta siyo duk wani abu. Ma'auni yana da kwanaki biyu kafin taron. Ta tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin aikace-aikacen ta na banki kuma ta aika da rasit tare da adadin, kwanan wata da ma'auni.

panel.heading: A biya lafiya

right: Bayar da wata ƙungiya daga aljihunka

say: Masu zamba suna aika SMS na karya da faɗakarwar hoton allo. Kada ka yarda da su. Rubuta adadin baƙon ku da sharuɗɗan sokewa akan ƙimar, don haka an amince da su kafin kowane kuɗi ya motsa.

say: Don tunawa. Kidaya kowane farashi kuma raba ta faranti. Farashi tare da gefe, ba alama ba. Dafa abinci mara alerji da farko, a rufe kuma a yi masa lakabi. Yi ajiya kafin siyayya. Kuma tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku na banki, ba ta hanyar SMS kaɗai ba.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Ƙididdige kowane farashi, sannan raba ta faranti
Farashin = farashi ÷ (1 - gefe)
Abincin da ba shi da Allergen: na farko, hatimi, mai lakabi
Saka ajiya kafin siyan kayan abinci
Tabbatar da biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin ku na banki

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Farashin fakitin menu guda ɗaya tare da farashin kasuwa na yanzu. Rubuta katunan sinadarai kuma yi alama akan allergens. Kuma ƙirƙiri ambaton ku, rikodin taron da samfuran saƙon martani.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
